question: Why are message queues used in distributed systems?
answer: Message queues decouple producers from consumers and allow asynchronous processing. They help smooth traffic spikes, improve reliability, and make retries easier when downstream services are busy or temporarily unavailable.
reference_answer: Message queues are used to decouple producers and consumers, absorb traffic spikes, enable asynchronous processing, improve reliability, and support retry mechanisms.
